item.title: v1.0.0 — Catch your year of work
item.description:
FocusDex v1.0 — out now

  • 147 creatures designed across 13 families (starters, time-of-day, app-context, weather, legendaries, food, meetings, brain rot, sleep, seasonal, mythicals, crossover, regional).
  • Catch minigame in Safari Mode — playable anytime, with or without a focus session.
  • Focus timer earns Pokéballs in real time — 5min = Focus Ball, 25min = Great, 90min = Ultra, 8hr = Master.
  • Onboarding starter selection — pick Codesprite, Inkling, or Pixibrush.
  • Full persistence — pokeballs, streak, and dex survive quits and reboots.
  • Polish: live menubar countdown, sound effects, haptics, right-click context menu, keyboard shortcuts (⌘N start, ⌘. stop, ⌘G catch).
